text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky triumphed in a fierce battle 
against Grass Wonder.

Riding the momentum of the fun race she 
had with her junior, she set her sights on 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn) as her next race.

Watching the two race right before her 
eyes, Special Week felt a fiery passion 
well up within her, different from the 
impatience she once felt.
